faq: Will a better listing rank higher?
We cannot promise rankings. Shopify's search weighs many signals we do not control. A clear name, honest description and good screenshots help merchants decide, which is what we work on.
Can you add reviews to my listing?
No. We do not write, buy or swap reviews, and doing so breaks Shopify's rules. Reviews have to come from real merchants who used your app.
What do you need from me?
A short description of what the app does, who it is for, your plans and a few screens or a test link. We write everything else and send it for your approval.
Do you follow Shopify's rules on names and icons?
Yes. We check name length, wording, icon size and screenshot rules, and avoid terms Shopify restricts. That reduces the chance of review feedback that delays your launch.
